Product Description

Experience the joy of cooking with the Cuisinart Classic® Collection. Stainless steel knives handle every job effortlessly with strength, stability and balance that give you total control. With a built-in sharpener in the block, blades maintain a precision edge for consistent cutting with every use. Any way you slice it, this superior cutlery has all the versatility you need to handle food prep like a pro.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Perfect for beginners
I consider myself a beginner when it comes to kitchenware and cooking. I wanted a sharp knife set on a block with a built in sharpened and this fit the bill. There was a desire to have a modern, mature and contemporary knife set in a kitchen in which the kettle is pistachio, the cabinets are plum and the walls have a hint of peach. This balances out the slightly whimsical kitchen while being practical, sharp and timeless. It’s been slicing through fruit and meat effortlessly. Also caught it before the price increase.

    Excellent set of knives!
    Reviewed in the United States on May 7, 2026
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.

    I couldn’t be happier with this 7-piece stainless steel cutlery block from Cuisinart. The knives are incredibly sharp right out of the box and hold their edge really well, even with frequent use. Each piece feels balanced and comfortable in hand, which makes prep work so much easier and more enjoyable.

    The stainless steel design gives it a clean, modern look that fits beautifully on the countertop without taking up too much space. I also appreciate how sturdy and well-made the block is—it doesn’t feel cheap or flimsy at all.

    For the price, this set is an excellent value. Whether you’re cooking daily meals or prepping for something bigger, it has everything you need. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a reliable, stylish knife set that performs like a higher-end product!

About this Item

  • Contoured stainless steel handle has a comfortable ergonomic grip
  • Precision blades taper to an exceptionally sharp cutting edge
  • High-quality stainless steel blades provide superior precision and accuracy
  • Set Includes: 8” Chef Knife, 8” Slicing Knife, 7” Santoku Knife, 5.5” Serrated Utility Knife, 3.5” Paring Knife, Stainless Steel Shears, Acacia Wood Block with Built in Sharpener

Product Description

Experience the joy of cooking with the Cuisinart Classic® Collection. Stainless steel knives handle every job effortlessly with strength, stability and balance that give you total control. With a built-in sharpener in the block, blades maintain a precision edge for consistent cutting with every use. Any way you slice it, this superior cutlery has all the versatility you need to handle food prep like a pro.
